text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Manchester City and Fulham at the Etihad Stadium!
City are looking to maintain their perfect start to the season and return to the top of the table with another win here today.
They've already beaten Burnley, Newcastle United and Sheffield United in the league, as well as adding the Super Cup to their trophy cabinet since the season started.
As for Fulham, they started their campaign with a victory, beating Everton 1-0 on the opening day, before losing to Brentford and snatching a late draw at Arsenal last weekend.
They come into this game on the back of a penalty shootout win against Tottenham, which saw them through to the EFL Cup third round in midweek.
There's no Pep Guardiola on the sidelines after his back surgery, and there are three changes to the City side that eventually got the better of Sheffield United last time out.
Doku comes in to make his debut, with Akanji and Foden also being brought in.
Gvardiol and Silva both drop to the bench, while Jack Grealish misses out due to a thigh problem.
New signing Nunes is on the bench after joining the club on Friday.
Marco Silva is back on the touchline after serving a ban, and he makes four changes from Fulham's EFL Cup game against Spurs in midweek.
Leno is back in goal, with Pereira, Wilson and Jimenez also coming in.
Rodak, Traore and Muniz start on the bench, as do Bassey and Willian as they return from suspension and injury respectively.
Joao Palhinha is not in the squad after his proposed move to Bayern Munich fell through on deadline day.

City have won their last 14 meetings with Fulham in all competitions – among Premier League/Football League clubs in competitive English football history, only the Citizens themselves have had a longer winning run against an opponent (15 against Watford).
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Haaland gets the game under way for City!
City are dominating all of the early possession here as they knock it around in front of Fulham.
The visitors are pressing high, but they can't get close to them at the moment.
Walker decides to go for a more direct route this time, sending it long to Alvarez.
It bounces off his shin out to Foden, but he is muscled off the ball by De Cordova-Reid, who looks to break.
Haaland drops deep to get on the ball and knocks it on to Kovacic so that he can make a run into the box.
It's swept out to Ake so he can swing a cross in, but it's too deep for the Norwegian.
Robinson steps in to cut out a sloppy pass from Akanji, and Fulham have the chance to play out from the back.
They neatly work it out to the right side, but Cairney's run is blocked off by Kovacic.
It's a great switch from Reed, and although there's too much on it for Cairney, the touch off his chest helps it to De Cordova-Reid.
He curls a delightful cross into the box, and Akanji gets a vital touch to take it away from Jimenez.
After winning back-to-back matches at the Etihad in April 2008 and April 2009, Fulham are winless in their last 12 visits to City in all competitions (drawn two, lost 10).
They have lost the last nine in a row by an aggregate score of 27-2.
Cairney has gone down in the middle of the field off the ball and he requires treatment on his knee.
The medical team is on, and Silva is readying a substitute in case it is needed.
Cairney shakes his head as he makes his way off the pitch after treatment.
He goes straight down the tunnel as Harris replaces him.
It's another sloppy pass from Akanji as he gifts the ball to De Cordova-Reid, and Fulham flood forward.
The Jamaican cannot pick out Pereira's run down the right though, and the hosts soon have possession back.
Both teams have struggled to keep hold of the ball in the last few minutes, and Fulham win it back once more.
Robinson drives down the left before trying to drill in a cross, but it's blocked by Doku.
Fulham are starting to enjoy themselves here and they're playing it brilliantly through midfield.
When it's knocked back to Diop, he lifts it over the top for Wilson, but he gets sandwiched between the two City centre-backs.
City are just upping the pressure now and Rodri chips it over the top for Foden, who has space on the right.
He drills it across the six-yard box first time, but nobody is in there for the hosts.
Doku does really well to get the better of Tete down the left and he clips a cross to the far post from the byline.
Foden's first touch is a good one, but Robinson steps in to take it off him before he can get a shot away.
What a run from Foden! It's laid off to him by Alvarez down the right and he weaves his way towards goal through a crowded box.
Leno thinks he's going to shoot so rushes off his line, but it's squared to Haaland instead, and Diop puts his laces through the clearance.
City have found their rhythm now and they're switching it from left to right and back again with confidence.
Fulham are staying compact, though, and making it hard for them to work it through the middle.
ALVAREZ SCORES! It's been coming in the last few minutes, and they've finally opened up Fulham! It's a brilliant throughball from Kovacic into Haaland, and Diop just gets caught wrong side.
The Norwegian unselfishly squares it into the middle to pick out Alvarez, who is left with a simple tap-in.
1-0 City!
Haaland has had a fairly quiet game so far, but he times his run perfectly this time to get in behind and sets up his team-mate.
REAM EQUALISES! Fulham weren't behind for long! They quickly work it upfield from the restart and win themselves a corner, which is swung into the box by Pereira.
Jimenez peels away at the near post to strike it on the volley, and Ederson gets a hand to it.
The ball bounces straight to Ream, who taps it in right on the line.
Fulham win a free-kick this time, and Pereira delivers another set-piece into the box.
City only half-clear their lines, and when it's put back into the area, Walker scrambles to get it away.
City are struggling to regain their momentum after the Fulham equaliser.
They're still looking to use their wide players, but they can't find a way through the visitors' high press.
Reed sends it long once more, and Wilson makes a great run down the right and looks to have gotten the better of Dias.
He breezes past him, but the defender recovers well to stop him from getting a sight of goal.
Rodri couldn't get back to stop De Cordova-Reid, and he just pushed the forward off the ball.
He's shown the first yellow card of the game.
It's a really poor challenge from Diop as he stretches over the ball and steps on Doku's foot.
He also goes into the referee's book.
Foden's free-kick is hit straight into the wall and Tete made the block, but is now down holding his head.
He goes through the checks with the medical team, and he'll be able to carry on.
Walker picks out Alvarez in space and he looks to play Foden in behind once more.
Robinson reads it well, though, and steps in to cut it out.
Robinson surges forward after intercepting the pass to Foden, but a heavy touch takes it away from him.
He crashes into Akanji before he can slow down, taking the defender out, and receives a yellow card for it.
AKE SCORES! City have a goal right before the break! Foden whips a brilliant corner into the box and Ake has a completely free header on the penalty spot.
He thumps his header back towards the near post and it bounces into the bottom corner.
After a VAR check to see if Akanji, in an offside position, is obstructing Leno, the goal stands.
2-1 City!
It's a wonderful delivery from Foden on the corner and he spots Ake in acres of space in the middle of the box.
Akanji jumps out of the way of Ake's header as it bounces into the ground, and it's not until it clears the defender that Leno dives.
It does look like he was blocking the keeper's view, but VAR doesn't see it that way, and the goal will stand.
Fulham are absolutely furious that Ake's goal stands, and they're crowding the referee as the protests continue.
Silva is also venting his frustrations from the sidelines, and the referee is giving them a moment to calm down before the game restarts.
HALF-TIME: MANCHESTER CITY 2-1 FULHAM
City score just before half-time to take a 2-1 lead into the break over Fulham.
The first 30 minutes of the game were tight, with neither side managing to create a single chance.
Alvarez actually scored with the first shot of the game on the half-hour mark, tapping in Haaland's low cross.
Just two minutes later, Fulham were level once more as Ream latched onto the loose ball after Ederson saved Jimenez's volley.
In stoppage time, Ake thumped in a header from a corner, and after a VAR check to see if Akanji was blocking Leno, it controversially stood.
City haven't been at their high-flying best, but despite creating very little in front of goal, they have scored with both of their shots on target.
They'll be looking to provide a bigger threat after the break.
Fulham need to use half-time to regain their composure after the frustration of that second City goal.
They've played well, though, and Silva will feel that they can get something out of this game.
Fulham get us under way for the second half!
Fulham are looking to make a quick start to the second half as it's played long to De Cordova-Reid.
He beats Walker for pace before playing a one-two with Jimenez.
When it comes back to him, his first-time effort from long range is fired high over the bar.
Walker gets his head down and drives down the right to get on the end of Kovacic's pass over the top.
He knocks it down for Haaland, but he can't get it out of his feet before Ream gets across to him.
City are seeing a lot of the ball in the opening exchanges of the second half here, but they're struggling to get it into the box.
It's played down the left for Haaland this time, but he's shrugged off it by Tete.
De Cordova-Reid isn't happy about something, and his protests see him get booked for dissent.
City are unbeaten in their last 46 Premier League matches when leading at half-time (won 43, drawn three), dating back to May 2021 against Brighton and Hove Albion, when they lost 3-2.
HAALAND SCORES! City pass it straight through the middle of Fulham as Rodri slides in Alvarez, who touches it towards the edge of the D.
Ream sticks out a leg to try and cut it out, but instead helps it into Haaland's path.
He's through on goal and makes no mistake as he slots it past Leno into the back of the net.
3-1 City!
Fulham look to make a quick response once more.
It's sent long over the top by Ream for Jimenez, and he checks back at the byline to lose Ake and pick out Harris.
He wasn't expecting it, and it bounces off him into Ederson's gloves.
The visitors have everyone sitting back in their own half as City continue to pass it around in front of them.
De Cordova-Reid eventually decides to press, but they still can't get near the ball.
Wilson cuts out a loose pass by Akanji and knocks it out to Jimenez on the right before bursting into the box.
The Welshman is screaming for it to be played back to him, but Ake gets across to stop that from happening.
CHANCE! Rodri threads it through the middle, and this time he picks out Haaland.
His first thought is to play Alvarez through on goal, and his first-time shot from a tight angle is blocked by Diop.
City are still dominating possession here, and it's all in their own half as they knock it comfortably around Fulham's high press.
PENALTY TO CITY! It's a wonderful pass over the top to pick out Alvarez, who has acres of space ahead of him.
He chests it down before running into the box and gets a nudge in the back from Diop, which sends him tumbling to the ground.
The referee points to the spot.
Pereira isn't happy with that penalty being awarded and his protests see him become the second Fulham player booked for dissent in this game.
HAALAND SCORES! It's a brilliant penalty from the Norwegian! He puts last week's penalty miss behind him as he goes for power here today.
Leno dives the wrong way, but he wouldn't have gotten near it anywhere as he rifles it into the left side of the net.
4-1 City!
Fulham can't get out of their own half at the moment, and City's high press is making things difficult for them.
Jimenez tries to hold it up as he waits for support on the halfway line, but Dias steps in to nick it off him.
There's a double change for Fulham here.
Tete is the first to go off, with Castagne coming on in his place to make his debut for the club.
De Cordova-Reid also makes way as Willian replaces him.
GREAT SAVE! Fulham aren't giving up yet, and Pereira bundles his way into the box before being shrugged off it by Dias.
It bounces through the Jimenez, who hits the shot first time.
It deflects off Ake's legs and Ederson stretches to tip it wide of the post.
City's first change is a double one.
Rodri is taken off for Silva.
And Doku's debut comes to an early end as Gomez is brought on for him.
Silva tracks back to stop Wilson's driving run and picks up a yellow card just minutes after coming onto the field.

Haaland has reached 50 goal involvements (41 goals, nine assists) in just 39 appearances in the Premier League, breaking Andrew Cole's record (43 games) to become the fastest player to do so in the competition.
Fulham are making another double change here.
Jimenez goes off for Muniz.
Traore also comes on to replace Wilson.
Fulham look tired as they chase City's passes around inside their own half, and they can't get close to the hosts.
Foden sweeps it out to Walker on the right and he swings a cross into the box, but Ream beats Haaland to it.
Phillips is being given a rare chance as he comes on in place of Kovacic.
Gomez gets the better of Castagne, and the loose ball rolls to Phillips, who hooks it towards Alvarez at the far post.
Leno watches it all the way to pluck it out of the air.
City may not be pushing forward with as much intent, but they're still causing Fulham problems here.
Walker tries to push his way past Robinson into the box, but the American stands his ground to stop him.
City's final change is a double one.
Alvarez is making way for Lewis.
Bobb also makes his senior debut for the club as he replaces Foden.
City are happy to just keep possession deep in their own half now as they look to see out the rest of stoppage time with their three-goal cushion.
Fulham committed a lot of bodies forward this time and it leaves City with space to counter into.
It's threaded forward for Bobb, who is urged to shoot by the home fans, but he dawdles over it and the chance gets away from him.
HAT-TRICK! Haaland scores his third goal of the game! Fulham can't get close to City as they work it down the left and Gomez jinks past Castagne to pull it back from the byline.
Haaland is left in space near the penalty spot and he hits the shot first time, drilling it low past Leno into the bottom corner.
5-1 City!
It's a great run by Gomez down the left as he weaves between the Fulham players to create space for himself to pull the ball back to Haaland.
FULL-TIME: MANCHESTER CITY 5-1 FULHAM
Haaland's hat-trick helps City to a 5-1 win to Fulham as their perfect start to the season continues.
The game took a little while to get going before Alvarez scored with the first shot of the game on the half-hour mark.
Just two minutes later though, Fulham were level as Ream latched onto Ederson's save to tap in from close range.
On the stroke of half-time, Ake controversially put City back ahead after VAR deemed Akanji wasn't blocking Leno's view from an offside position.
All three second-half goals came courtesy of Haaland, slotting in two well-taken finishes on either side of a penalty, which Alvarez won after being bundled over by Diop.
City make it four wins from four and they go back to the top of the table before the international break.
They travel to unbeaten West Ham in two weeks' time.
Fulham are now winless in three and will be looking to turn things around against Luton Town next time out.
That's all for today, goodbye!
